posts.text: Tax on debt and fund of funds — Hello @tax007 Capital gains from US Stock or funds of Indian AMC investing in US market would not be treated as debt funds and hence the changes in capital gains for pre and post April 2023 would not be applicable. The taxability depends on the period of holding if the funds have been held for less than 24 months then it would be treated as STCG taxable at slab rates otherwise LTCG taxable at 12.5%. If the gains are STCG taxable at slab rates then benefit of rebate under 87A would be applicable.
